segments.name: Commercial Banking
products: commercial and industrial lending and leasing
segments.description: Traditional banking operations providing loans, deposits and treasury services to commercial and consumer customers in its market area.
segments.evidence: The first line of business, or segment, is our traditional banking operations, serving both commercial and consumer customers.

segments.name: Wealth Management and Advisory Services
segments.description: Registered investment advisory subsidiary delivering wealth management and financial planning guidance to professionals, higher net worth individuals and bank customers.
segments.evidence: Meridian Wealth, a registered investment advisor and wholly-owned subsidiary of the Bank, provides a comprehensive array of wealth management services and products and the trusted guidance to help its clients and our banking customers prepare for the future.

segments.name: Mortgage Banking
products: loans to be held within our portfolio
segments.description: Originates residential mortgage loans for homeowners and smaller scale investors, selling most loans to secondary market investors while often retaining servicing.
segments.evidence: Originations consist of consumer for-sale mortgage loans, loans to be held within our portfolio, and wholesale mortgage loans and home equity loans.

revenueModel.text: Clients and customers pay the corporation for loans, deposits, treasury services, wealth management advice and mortgage originations, generating interest and non-interest revenue.
revenueModel.evidence: We have a financial services business model with non-interest revenue streams from mortgage banking, the sale of SBA loan guarantees and wealth management services.
